components.name: Transport Play
components.html: <button class="ds-transport-play" aria-label="Play animation"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7 4 13 8-13 8z" fill="currentColor"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-transport-play { width: 44px; height: 44px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: 2px; color: #050709; background: #dae2e6; transition: background 180ms ease, transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-transport-play:hover { background: #9ad7e8; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-transport-play:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9ad7e8; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Instrument Button
components.description: A flat technical action for view presets.
components.css: .ds-instrument-button { height: 38px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 2px; color: #87949b; background: #0b0f12; font: 600 9px/1.4 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .1em; } .ds-instrument-button:hover { color: #9ad7e8; background: #111a1f; } .ds-instrument-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9ad7e8; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Live Status
components.description: A status readout, not a decorative pill.
components.css: .ds-live-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; color: #87949b; font: 600 9px/1.4 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .16em; } .ds-live-status i { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #9ad7e8; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(154, 215, 232, .5); }

narrative.overview: The interface behaves like a dark aerospace evaluation room: the aircraft is the instrument under test and the UI is only the calibrated equipment around it. It is immersive without pretending to be a game HUD.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black tonal layers with cold, directional illumination
Condensed instrument labels used only for identity, status, and measurement
One ice-blue active state and rare caution-amber orientation marks
Flat control surfaces; depth belongs primarily to the 3D scene

rules.name: The Live Signal Rule
rules.body: Radar Ice appears only when the system is active, interactive, or focused. Caution Amber appears only where the user needs a singular orientation cue.

rules.name: The Instrument Type Rule
rules.body: Condensed uppercase text must name a state, measurement, identity, or action; it is not used as body copy.

dos: Do keep the aircraft as the brightest and largest object in the viewport.
Do use lines and readouts to clarify real state or interaction.
Do let active controls become brighter while inactive controls stay quiet.
Do preserve a usable keyboard focus state and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't turn the interface into a fictional weapons HUD or add fabricated performance claims.
Don't scatter neon glows, gradients on text, or decorative glass cards.
Don't use rounded cards as the default container for every control group.
Don't let interface chrome cover the aircraft on small screens.
